series: Gartner Top Strategic Predictions (Top Predictions for IT Organizations and Users)

entries.quote: By 2027, the productivity value of AI will be recognized as a primary economic indicator of national power.
entries.subject: AI productivity as economic indicator

entries.quote: By 2027, GenAI tools will be used to explain legacy business applications and create appropriate replacements, reducing modernization costs by 70%.
entries.subject: GenAI for legacy application modernization

entries.quote: By 2028, enterprise spend on battling malinformation will surpass $30 billion, cannibalizing 10% of marketing and cybersecurity budgets to combat a multifront threat.
entries.subject: Malinformation defense spending
entries.note: Also: cannibalizing 10% of marketing and cybersecurity budgets.

entries.quote: By 2027, 45% of chief information security officers (CISOs) will expand their remit beyond cybersecurity, due to increasing regulatory pressure and attack surface expansion.
entries.subject: CISO remit expansion
entries.metric: share of CISOs expanding remit beyond cybersecurity

entries.quote: By 2028, the rate of unionization among knowledge workers will increase by 1,000%, motivated by the adoption of GenAI.
entries.subject: Knowledge worker unionization
entries.metric: increase in unionization rate among knowledge workers

entries.quote: In 2026, 30% of workers will leverage digital charisma filters to achieve previously unattainable advances in their career.
entries.subject: Digital charisma filters
entries.metric: share of workers using digital charisma filters

entries.quote: By 2027, 25% of Fortune 500 companies will actively recruit neurodivergent talent across conditions like autism, ADHD and dyslexia to improve business performance.
entries.subject: Neurodivergent talent recruitment
entries.metric: share of Fortune 500 companies actively recruiting neurodivergent talent

entries.quote: Through 2026, 30% of large companies will have a dedicated business unit or sales channels to access fast-growing machine customer markets.
entries.subject: Machine customers
entries.metric: share of large companies with a dedicated business unit or sales channel for machine customers

entries.quote: By 2028, there will be more smart robots than frontline workers in manufacturing, retail and logistics due to labor shortages.
entries.subject: Smart robots vs frontline workers
entries.note: Comparative claim: more smart robots than frontline workers in manufacturing, retail and logistics.

entries.quote: By 2026, 50% of G20 members will experience monthly electricity rationing, turning energy-aware operations into either a competitive advantage or a major failure risk.
entries.subject: Electricity rationing
entries.metric: share of G20 members with monthly electricity rationing

notes: Edition covers '2024 and beyond'. Gartner's stated count: 10 (press release: 'top 10 strategic predictions'). Gartner's URL slug misspells 'beyond' as 'byond'. Quotes are the prediction headline sentences as printed in the press release; body text is not stored.
